title: Course withdrawal request
description: Use the official eService request and the relevant academic and financial deadlines.
descriptionAr: استخدم طلب الخدمة الإلكترونية الرسمي وراجع المواعيد الأكاديمية والمالية المناسبة.
verificationNote: Use the current official page for portal labels, applicable term and eligibility. This checklist does not submit a request or verify your private university record. Do not generalize a full-university W rule to every single-course withdrawal.
verificationNoteAr: تحقق من المسميات والفصل والأهلية في الصفحة الرسمية الحالية. لا ترسل هذه القائمة الطلب ولا تتحقق من سجلك الجامعي الخاص.
scopeNote: Do not generalize a full-university W rule to every single-course withdrawal.

steps.title: Check your term
steps.instruction: Check your term: consult the academic calendar’s withdrawal/drop-without-failure deadline.
steps.instructionAr: تحقق من الفصل: راجع موعد الانسحاب أو الحذف دون رسوب في التقويم الأكاديمي.

steps.title: Submit the official request
steps.instruction: Submit the official request: the financial-obligations page requires an eService request for university/course withdrawal or registration suspension; stopping attendance is not submission.
steps.instructionAr: قدّم الطلب الرسمي: تتطلب صفحة الالتزامات المالية طلباً عبر الخدمات الإلكترونية للانسحاب من الجامعة أو المساق أو تعليق التسجيل؛ والتوقف عن الحضور ليس تقديم طلب.

steps.title: Check financial effects
steps.instruction: Check financial effects: the submission date and course system determine financial obligations; complete required clearance for a refund.
steps.instructionAr: تحقق من الآثار المالية: يتحدد الالتزام بتاريخ التقديم ونظام المساق، ويستلزم استرداد الرسوم إكمال إخلاء الطرف المطلوب.

sources.title: UAEU Academic Calendar
sources.evidenceText: Academic year 2026–27 calendar: Fall 2026 add/drop starts 17 August, last add 28 August, last withdraw/drop without failure 18 September; Spring 2027 corresponding dates 4 January, 15 January and 5 February. General final-exam periods: 6–15 December 2026 and 1–10 May 2027. These are term-specific dates, not individual class/exam appointments or another year's schedule.

sources.title: UAEU Withdrawal Deadlines and Financial Obligations
sources.evidenceText: The current Withdrawal Deadlines and Financial Obligations page requires an eService request for university/course withdrawal or registration suspension. Financial obligations follow submission date; refunds follow required clearance. Fall 2026 FULL-SEMESTER courses: 100% refund for requests 24 August–18 September, full tuition responsibility after 18 September. Monthly and quarterly course systems have separate dates. This source does not itself define transcript grades for an individual course.

sources.title: UAEU Course Registration Service Guide
sources.evidenceText: The registration guide page 5 documents dropping a registered class through the Action menu, selecting Drop-Web and pressing Submit.

sources.title: UAEU Undergraduate Registration and Enrollment Procedure
sources.sourceVersion: Effective2018-08-12; review due2021-09-01; no supersession certification
sources.evidenceText: Published effective-2018 undergraduate policy excludes the College of Medicine and Health Sciences; later supersession not established. AE-03 procedure 6 permits term-specific add/drop changes. Procedure7 distinguishes full-university withdrawal/leave: before end of week 4 courses are not recorded; after week 4 through week 6 W applies to all classes. This full-university rule is not a universal grade rule for a single-course withdrawal.
